chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them both), who said: Burayda said to me,
God's Messenger ordered us to greet your father with the title 'Commander of the Faithful'.
ai.seo_question: What title did the Prophet Muhammad order people to use when greeting Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the early recognition of Imam Ali’s (AS) military and spiritual leadership through the title 'Amirat al-Mu'minin,' a designation often associated with his role at the Battle of Khaybar. It underscores the continuity of prophetic authority within the Ahl al-Bayt, linking the Prophet’s direct instruction to the later Imams, particularly Imam al-Rida (AS), as recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-313 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s.), “Burayda told me that
God’s Prophet (S) ordered that they (the people) call my father the Commander of the Faithful (a.s.).”
